subject.title: feat: Plugin API for TUI footer status contributions (registerStatusProvider)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public PluginStatusProvider/registerStatusProvider SDK seam now, and what method name, return shape, provider multiplicity, and render boundary should be accepted before release?
rationale: This crosses the public Plugin SDK contract and future TUI rendering semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve API-only seam after refresh
options.body: Accept the narrow registry/SDK seam once the branch is current and the method name, return type, multiplicity, and follow-up render boundary are explicitly approved.

options.title: Hold for broader footer design
options.body: Keep the issue open and pause the API until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53774 settles ordering, truncation, theming, and footer placement semantics.

options.title: Decline this SDK surface
options.body: Close the implementation path if maintainers decide persistent footer/status contribution should stay outside the Plugin SDK for now.

recommendation.title: Approve API-only seam after refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow registry/SDK seam once the branch is current and the method name, return type, multiplicity, and follow-up render boundary are explicitly approved.

likelyOwner.reason: History and policy evidence point to this as a plugin API/product-boundary decision, and steipete has foundational and recent ownership signals in the relevant plugin SDK surfaces.
